title: Valkyrie no Densetsu - Theme of Lava Cave
description:
Catchy song that plays in the Lava Cave of Valkyrie no Densetsu for the arcade/PSX.
Originally ported for the hack TEN B-Side.

Not compatible with
- Yoshi
- Thunder / Blargg
- Bonus End
